bundle.shortDescription: Local-first, end-to-end encrypted notes for developers
bundle.longDescription: AnkyLock is a local-first, end-to-end encrypted scratchpad and notes app for developers. Notes are encrypted on your device with a key that only your passphrase can produce, and sync through your own Google Drive as ciphertext.
